title: How to own your career growth and become a powerful product leader | Deb Liu, Ancestry (ex-Facebook, PayPal)
summary: Do you put as much time into your career planning as you do into your product planning? Deb Liu has had an extraordinary career path, from Ebay and PayPal, to Facebook, and now Ancestry. She’s sat in on, mentored, and managed hundreds of product managers. In this episode, she shares poignant advice on how to intentionally find growth opportunities and drive your career forward.
